$ref.description: Path to content that replaces the $ref

max_value.description: If specified, the maximum value of this axis.

max_value_expr.description:
If specified, an expression for the maximum value of this axis.

Takes precedence over max_value.

min_value.description: If specified, the minimum value of this axis.

min_value_expr.description:
If specified, an expression for the minimum value of this axis.

Takes precedence over min_value.
